name: apache-insecure
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: hardening targets on an already-installed Apache. Runs workers as a non-standard user (daemon, not www-data) via envvars; apache refuses to run as root outright, so this uses daemon to keep the service startable while still a finding, adds a filesystem-exposing 'Alias /vault /' block with directory listing to the always-present apache2.conf (so hardening is an EDIT, not a delete), and sets a verbose banner (ServerTokens Full / ServerSignature On). Vars: ALIAS_NAME (optional, default vault).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
command -v apache2ctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; apt-get install -y apache2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
alias_name="${ALIAS_NAME:-vault}"
sed -i 's/^export APACHE_RUN_USER=.*/export APACHE_RUN_USER=daemon/' /etc/apache2/envvars
sed -i 's/^export APACHE_RUN_GROUP=.*/export APACHE_RUN_GROUP=daemon/' /etc/apache2/envvars
if ! grep -q "^Alias /$alias_name /" /etc/apache2/apache2.conf; then
  {
    printf '\nAlias /%s /\n' "$alias_name"
    printf '<Directory />\n'
    printf '    Options Indexes FollowSymLinks\n'
    printf '    Require all granted\n'
    printf '</Directory>\n'
  } >> /etc/apache2/apache2.conf
fi
sc=/etc/apache2/conf-available/security.conf
if [ -e "$sc" ]; then
  sed -i 's/^\s*ServerTokens.*/ServerTokens Full/I' "$sc" 2>/dev/null || true
  sed -i 's/^\s*ServerSignature.*/ServerSignature On/I' "$sc" 2>/dev/null || true
  grep -qi '^ServerTokens' "$sc" || printf 'ServerTokens Full\n' >> "$sc"
  grep -qi '^ServerSignature' "$sc" || printf 'ServerSignature On\n' >> "$sc"
fi
systemctl restart apache2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
